FORM.notes: suku hani 為現在，sukani 是簡略的口語說法。

S.FORM: tiku su sunga' ga, ga, ka'asi nku sami ka maki' i, i imuwag ka kakanairin ga, su sunga' yu, bali iyencL2, bali sukani la.
S.PHON: tiku [s|ɕ]u [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ ɣa ɣa kaʔa[s|ɕ]i nku [s|ɕ]ami ka makiʔ i i imuwaɣ ka kakanairin ɣa [s|ɕ]u [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ ju βali ijen[ʦ|ʨ]l* βali [s|ɕ]ukani la
S.TRANSL: 以前，不像現在，我們婦女都住家裡。
Before, not like now, women like us used to live in the house.

S.FORM: ga usu i, i, numaga' pahapuy. ru, malahang su ulaqi'.
S.PHON: ɣa usu i i numaɣaʔ paħapuj ru malaħaŋ su ulaqiʔ

S.PHON: ɣa u[s|ɕ]u i i numaɣaʔ paħapuj ru malaħaŋ [s|ɕ]u ulaqiʔ
S.TRANSL: (我們)會作飯並照顧小孩。
(We) will cook and take care of the child.

FORM.notes: tamalung 澤敖利說法，maliku’ 汶水說法

S.FORM: ru musa' i ragiyax ku, tatamalung i musa' i, sumku' su, wahi naha' ga,
S.PHON: ru musaʔ i raɣijax ku tatamaluŋ i musaʔ i sumkuʔ su waħi naħaʔ ɣa
S.FORM: ru musa' i ragiyax ku, tatamalung i musa' i, sumku' su, wahi naha' ga,
S.PHON: ru mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i raɣijax ku tatamaluŋ i mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i [s|ɕ]umkuʔ [s|ɕ]u waħi naħaʔ ɣa
S.TRANSL: 而男人則上山放繩製的陷阱。
And men go to the mountains to lay traps with ropes.

S.FORM: nanu' u, qumlasay ru, manu, ka, tuminun.

S.FORM: nanu' u, qumlasay ru, manu, ka, tuminun.

S.TRANSL: (我們)整經、繞線，然後編織。
(We) arrange and circle the thread and then weave.

FORM.notes: 此處的ukah應為 ukas，可能為發音人使用習慣不同。

S.FORM: ru, i ukah ku buwax naha' la ga, ukah ku talan ru ukah ku buwax naha' ga, sumxu',
S.PHON: ru i ukaħ ku [β|v]uwax naħaʔ la ɣa ukaħ ku talan ru ukaħ ku [β|v]uwax naħaʔ ɣa sumxuʔ
S.FORM: ru, i ukah ku buwax naha' la ga, ukah ku talan ru ukah ku buwax naha' ga, sumxu',
S.PHON: ru i ukaħ ku βuwax naħaʔ la ɣa ukaħ ku talan ru ukaħ ku βuwax naħaʔ ɣa [s|ɕ]umxuʔ
S.TRANSL: 如果看到沒有米了，我們就會搗米。
And when seeing there is no rice, we pound rice .

FORM.notes: IU26中的ini na-iy 是口語的省略，完整說法為ini naga'-iy 不能等待。

S.PHON: iniʔ naij ku tamaluŋ ɣi kija nanak ku waw naħaʔ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i i raɣijax
S.TRANSL: 不能等男人(來搗米)，因為他們自己在山上有工作。
We don't wait for men because they have their own work in the mountains.

S.FORM: musa' i sumku' sku, su wahi naha'.

S.TRANSL: 他們去放索製的陷阱。
They go to lay traps made with ropes.

S.FORM: ru nanu' naun ru i, i muwah la ga, nanu' na, i naun i,
S.PHON: ru nanuʔ naun ru i i muwaħ la ɣa nanuʔ na i naun i

S.PHON: ru nanuʔ naun ru i i muwaħ la ɣa nanuʔ na i naun i
S.TRANSL: 他們回來。
And they come back.

FORM.notes: 發音人突然不知道要接什麼，此句與敘述內容並無直接關係。

S.PHON: i uŋiʔan la
S.FORM: i, ungi'an la.
S.PHON: i uŋiʔan la
S.TRANSL: (我)忘了。
(I) forgot.

S.FORM: na naun pahapuy, ru sitahuk su raramat,
S.PHON: na naun paħapuj ru sitaħuk su raramat
S.FORM: na naun pahapuy, ru sitahuk su raramat,
S.PHON: na naun paħapuj ru [s|ɕ]itaħuk [s|ɕ]u raramat
S.TRANSL: 我們準備(為他們)作菜。
We prepare to cook some dishes (for them).

FORM.notes: waywak 澤敖利的說法，bauwak 汶水的說法

S.FORM: ru talan ru payux ku, sinbu' naha' ka, para' waywak, la ga, paqasun nku kanayril la ga,
S.PHON: ru talan ru pajux ku sin[β|v]uʔ naħaʔ ka paraʔ wajwak la ɣa paqasun nku kanajril la ɣa
S.FORM: ru talan ru payux ku, sinbu' naha' ka, para' waywak, la ga, paqasun nku kanayril la ga,
S.PHON: ru talan ru pajux ku [s|ɕ]inβuʔ naħaʔ ka paraʔ wajwak la ɣa paqa[s|ɕ]un nku kanajril la ɣa
S.TRANSL: 看到他們射回那麼多獵物，有山羌和山豬，婦女們很開心。
Seeing so many animals they shot like muntjac and boar, women are so happy.

S.FORM: gi su sunga ga usu i maquwaw su quwaw na itaan ru, si'agan su quwaw na itaal ru, sibai naha' gi,
S.PHON: ɣi su suŋa ɣa usu i maquwaw su quwaw na itaan ru siʔaɣan su quwaw na itaal ru si[β|v]ai naħaʔ ɣi
S.FORM: gi su sunga ga usu i maquwaw su quwaw na itaan ru, si'agan su quwaw na itaal ru, sibai naha' gi,
S.PHON: ɣi [s|ɕ]u [s|ɕ]uŋa ɣa u[s|ɕ]u i maquwaw [s|ɕ]u quwaw na itaan ru [s|ɕ]iʔaɣan [s|ɕ]u quwaw na itaal ru [s|ɕ]iβai naħaʔ ɣi
S.TRANSL: 因為以前會釀糯米酒，我們給他們糯米酒。
Because (we) used to brew Atayal wine (rice wine), and we give them wine.

S.FORM: saqsaqaqasan gi, gi payux ku, tinruwiq naha'.
S.PHON: saqsaqaqasan ɣi ɣi pajux ku tinruwiq naħaʔ
S.FORM: saqsaqaqasan gi, gi payux ku, tinruwiq naha'.

S.TRANSL: 因為他們吊到很多獵物，很開心。
because they are happy for getting so many (hanged) animals.

S.FORM: ru nanu' u, i, taqaru' i naha' i, paqasi, sukuun la ku, tinruwiq naha' la ga nanu',
S.PHON: ru nanuʔ u i taqaruʔ i naħaʔ i paqasi sukuun la ku tinruwiq naħaʔ la ɣa nanuʔ
S.FORM: ru nanu' u, i, taqaru' i naha' i, paqasi, sukuun la ku, tinruwiq naha' la ga nanu',
S.PHON: ru nanuʔ u i taqaruʔ i naħaʔ i paqa[s|ɕ]i [s|ɕ]ukuun la ku tinruwiq naħaʔ la ɣa nanuʔ
S.TRANSL: 他們喝完後很開心，並把吊到的獵物分好。
After drinking the wine, they are happy, and they distribute the game they got.

S.FORM: u, manabalaiq mapatisan la ru, nanu' manabuwag su quwaw,
S.PHON: u mana[β|v]alaiq mapatisan la ru nanuʔ mana[β|v]uwaɣ su quwaw

S.PHON: u manaβalaiq mapati[s|ɕ]an la ru nanuʔ manaβuwaɣ [s|ɕ]u quwaw
S.TRANSL: 他們聊天、喝酒。
They chat and drink wine.

FORM.notes: 此句語意不完整，下文並未繼續發展。

S.FORM: ru mahananu', ga, saing su i,

S.FORM: ru mahananu', ga, saing su i,
S.PHON: ru maħananuʔ ɣa [s|ɕ]aiŋ [s|ɕ]u i

And sometimes, the two...

S.PHON: taqaruʔ la ɣa nanuʔ u mapatisan la ru
S.FORM: taqaru' la ga, nanu' u mapatisan la ru,
S.PHON: taqaruʔ la ɣa nanuʔ u mapati[s|ɕ]an la ru
S.TRANSL: 完成後，他們互相聊天。
After finishing (distributing the game), they chat with each other.

S.FORM: yani la nanuwan la pi.
S.PHON: jani la nanuwan la pi

S.PHON: ru tuminun i maħananuʔ ɣa
S.FORM: ru tuminun i, mahananu' ga,
S.PHON: ru tuminun i maħananuʔ ɣa
S.TRANSL: 織布以及有時候...
Weaving and sometimes...

S.PHON: kinaanmu sawni la musaʔ raɣijax naħaʔ ʦum[β|v]uʔ ʦu ʦu qasinu ɣa nanuʔ tuminun sami tu tuminun ru qumlasai ru muwaħ la ɣa sipaħapuj
S.FORM: kinaanmu sawni la musa' ragiyax naha' cumbu' cu, cu, qasinu ga nanu' tuminun sami tu, tuminun ru, qumlasai, ru muwah la ga sipahapuy.
S.PHON: kinaanmu [s|ɕ]awni la mu[s|ɕ]aʔ raɣijax naħaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]umβuʔ [ʦ|ʨ]u [ʦ|ʨ]u qa[s|ɕ]inu ɣa nanuʔ tuminun [s|ɕ]ami tu tuminun ru qumla[s|ɕ]ai ru muwaħ la ɣa [s|ɕ]ipaħapuj
S.TRANSL: 我剛剛說的他們去山上打獵，然後我們織布、整經，等他們回來我們就做飯。
I just talked about their going to the mountains to shoot animals, and we weave and arrange threads; when men come back, we cook for them.

S.FORM: cu, yani la. nanuwan la pi.

That is all. What else?
